response.overview: "Replaced" is a psychological sci-fi short film that dives into the "Uncanny Valley" of our own homes. When a man is supplanted by a superior synthetic double, he must fight to reclaim a life that no longer seems to need him.
response.tagline: HAUNTED BY THE GHOST OF HER PAST AND SEDUCED BY THE PROMISE OF ARTIFICIAL COMPANIONSHIP, A YOUNG WOMAN GRAPPLES WITH LONELINESS IN A WORLD INCREASINGLY DOMINATED BY AI.
response.title: Replaced
